contribution.position: Restating: the reliability evidence opposes shipping this week. artifact:perf-report shows peak queue_depth of 4200 items against a 1000-item budget (over 4x capacity), and artifact:incident-log shows both of last quarter's sev2 incidents were retry storms — precisely the failure mode sustained queue overload aggravates. The 412/0 test pass and 87% coverage in artifact:test-report do not exercise this load path, so green tests do not close the gap.
